claim.quote: Neutrino and antineutrino total charged current cross sections on iron were measured in the 100, 160, and 200 GeV narrow band beams at the CERN SPS in the energy range 10 to 200 GeV.

name: Total neutrino and antineutrino charged current cross section measurements in 100, 160, and 200 GeV narrow band beams

summary.plain: CDHS measured how likely neutrinos and antineutrinos are to hit iron nuclei in CERN's narrow-band beams, from 10 to 200 GeV. The probability per unit energy stays constant, a basic input to tests of the quark model.
summary.technical: Total nu and nu-bar charged-current cross sections on iron in the 100, 160 and 200 GeV SPS narrow-band beams, 10-200 GeV: sigma/E = (0.686 +- 0.019)e-38 cm^2/GeV/nucleon (nu) and (0.339 +- 0.010)e-38 (nu-bar), corrected for non-isoscalarity; no energy dependence of sigma/E between 50 and 150 GeV within +-3 % (nu) and +-4 % (nu-bar).

title: Total neutrino and antineutrino charged current cross section measurements in 100, 160, and 200 GeV narrow band beams
why_it_matters: High-precision total neutrino cross sections used for decades as normalisation of neutrino-nucleon scattering and for tests of scaling and of the quark-parton model.
